description: DESTRUCTIVE: replace the live page content with a historical checkpoint. Run history_compare first. The server verifies expectedChecksum against the live document (409 CHECKSUM_MISMATCH on concurrent edits), durably pins the pre-restore content as an undo baseline checkpoint (aborting if that pin fails), then moves the page to a FRESH collaboration session — an active session is never overwritten. confirmRestore=true AND confirmLive=true are REQUIRED literals (restore changes the canonical live worker document; collaboration/browser delivery remains unverified), and idempotencyKey is REQUIRED so retries replay the durable receipt instead of staging repeated sessions. Success proves storage + checksum readback only — never collaboration sync or browser rendering.
name: opentrain_job_instructions_history_restore
